dct_description_sm: The Open Data Strategy provides a high level overview of the Region of Peel's goals and direction with Open Data.  This document is not a policy and is not binding.  The document's purpose is to set a general direction that will be iteratively worked on and improved over time.  The Strategy only covers the area of Open Data and not the other two major pillars of Open Government: Open Information and Open Dialogue.
